cases.name: 1. Profile view & edit: updating profile through API persists to PostgreSQL and is visible to Core
cases.details: Profile update via POST /api/account/profile persists to PostgreSQL identity.profiles and is immediately and consistently read by Core via core.read.

cases.name: 2. Practice cloud save: monotonic save revisions through API persist to profile.profile_saves and survive round-trips
cases.details: Cloud practice saves advance revision monotonically (0 -> 1 -> 2) in profile.profile_saves; stale revisions reject with 409 SAVE_CONFLICT; payloads round-trip intact.

cases.name: 3. Privacy-aware visibility: public vs friends vs private profiles hide/show stats appropriately
cases.details: Privacy visibility matrix enforced: self sees full stats; stranger sees public stats; non-friend receives hidden stats for friends-only and private profiles; blocked players return 404 PROFILE_NOT_FOUND.

cases.name: 4. Friend graph: friend request, accept, search, and list friends work correctly in PostgreSQL social tables
cases.details: Friendship lifecycle (request, accept, list, search by prefix/tag, remove) works correctly in social.friend_requests and social.friendships.

cases.name: 5. Cross-service consistency between API and Core: same actor ID queries identical database state and api_runtime respects grants
cases.details: Core service and API observe identical database rows for profiles and friends; api_runtime role strictly enforces least privilege (direct economic writes fail with 42501).

cases.name: 6. Account export, deletion status, deletion tag check, and unlink last-method safety
cases.details: Export returns profile/identities/saves/wallet views; deletion status returns policy version; delete requires exact tag confirmation; unlink rejects removing last authentication method (409 LAST_LOGIN_METHOD).

verification.summary: Account, social, practice, and read APIs implemented in apps/api using api_runtime role. Privacy-aware visibility rules enforced; cross-service data consistency between Vercel API and Game Core proven across 6 dedicated tests on real PG16.

not_claimed: V5-11-03 competitive effects routing to Core
